# Phase One — Limitless Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos is beyond every frame, yet Awtsmoos.com may reveal one intention through many clean vessels; motion may glow without noise, and depth may show without choice becoming a maze.

## Ideal experience universe

- Every route opens with immediate orientation, one primary action, and advanced controls hidden behind explicit disclosure.
- Navigation becomes context-aware, thumb-friendly, keyboard-complete, and never covers content accidentally.
- Every visual module has a local root scope; no selector escapes its route or component vessel.
- Each page owns a documented z-index scale with only the layers it actually needs.
- Layouts use container-aware grids, logical properties, safe-area insets, minmax sizing, and overflow guards.
- Motion communicates state: enter, reveal, press, focus, success, loading, expansion, and spatial continuity.
- Reduced-motion users receive equally clear state changes without decorative movement.
- Dense expert tools progressively disclose inspectors, filters, metadata, logs, and secondary actions.
- Search becomes a first-class command surface wherever catalog or documentation density warrants it.
- Empty, loading, offline, permission, error, and success states are designed rather than incidental.
- Cards are not decorative boxes: every card has hierarchy, purpose, action affordance, and responsive behavior.
- Mobile surfaces use compact headers, retractable rails, bottom-safe navigation, and no horizontal overflow.
- Desktop surfaces expand into multi-rail workspaces only when width can support them.
- Interactive elements expose hover, active, focus-visible, disabled, busy, selected, expanded, and invalid states.
- APIs use explicit gateways, validators, request models, response models, error translators, and observable state.
- Repeated behavior becomes data-driven registries rather than duplicated branching.
- Rich JSDoc describes intent, contracts, failure modes, side effects, and architectural position.
- CSS token values remain local to a product surface, with shared values imported only into explicit scopes.
- Documentation explains user workflows first, then architecture, APIs, evidence, troubleshooting, and extension points.
- Browser verification includes viewport width checks, computed overflow checks, focus traversal, dialog/rail behavior, and console errors.

## North star

Simple at first glance. Powerful on demand. Fast on touch. Exact on keyboard. Beautiful under scrutiny. No page should feel like a forgotten annex of the platform.
